methodology.summary: Entity lifecycle status is calculated from recency, development activity, relationship density, geographic reach, linked-development importance, and entity-type-specific time decay.
methodology.momentum: Momentum remains null with status "insufficient_history" until at least 45 days of knowledge history exist. This prevents new entities from being falsely classified as accelerating.
methodology.preservation: No entity is deleted. Dormant, historical, merged, and deprecated entities remain available through the Time Machine.
methodology.registry: The top-level entities array contains lifecycle metadata for every entity; rankings are presentation views over the same registry.
